items.abstract: <jats:p>In modern times, advertising is a widely employed marketing strategy primarily aimed at informing consumers about product qualities and promoting them through various means. Advertising is a refined art form, serving as a business strategy to introduce products and attract buyers. Essentially, it involves disseminating information through printed materials or rented advertising spaces to inform and influence potential buyers about a product's qualities. Initially, advertising began with wall writings, handbills, and posters. In the 21st century, the widespread use of digital technology, particularly internet-based technology, has introduced new advertising media. The advent of computer technology has brought significant changes, particularly in the field of graphic design. As a creative medium, graphic design provides advertising with the opportunity to express creativity and enhances the potential for product promotion and aesthetic appeal. To meet consumer needs and preferences, graphic design presents products in a way that facilitates rational purchasing decisions. Traditional materials, combined with models and products, guide the public creatively. Beauty is consistently showcased in various product scenes or TV commercials in advertisements. With graphic design, there have been numerous improvements in visualization, modification, and finalization of advertisements, resulting in high-quality aesthetic presentations. The greatest advantage of graphic design and computer technology in advertising is the enhanced quality and aesthetic presentation.</jats:p>
title: The visual appeal of graphic design in advertising campaigns

items.abstract: <jats:p>The purpose of the article is to understand the synthesis and cautious term system of specific artistic features of an advertising poster at every stage of the stylistic evolution for the effective practice of modern graphic designers in creating a variety of advertising images by stylisation. The research methodology is based on the use of systematic art review, stylistic, and comparative analysis of artistic advertising products of the 1870s‐2010s to determine the evolution of artistic styles of commercial advertising posters. The scientific novelty of the study is to conduct a comprehensive analysis of advertising posters over the specified period to learn the development of their visual language as a system of artistic and figurative means, and swipe files for modern graphic designers to implement stylised advertising graphics following each artistic style. The article describes typical signs of advertising posters at each historical stage with the following components of the graphic design project: composition, the principle of stylised image, colour, typography, and the effects of applying technical resources at each new stage. We have provided examples of modern stylisation for advertising posters following the styles of previous eras. Conclusions. In the general cultural and historical context of the epoch, an advertising poster represents typical features of the artistic style of each historical period. The study of these features and mastering the stylised skills of style patterns after each specific period gives modern graphic designers the chance to develop variable brand visual systems.</jats:p>
title: Evolution of Artistic Styles of Commertial Advertising Posters of the Context of History of Graphic Design
